leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply the react-window library to install and import the necessary components for list virtualization.
Define a fixed-size list component using the FixedSizeList component from react-window.
Construct a data array to serve as the source for the virtualized list items.
Implement a function component to render each individual row with the provided data and style.
Utilize the itemSize prop to control the height of each row in the virtualized list.
Assign the data array to the itemData prop to pass information to each row renderer.
Handle the itemCount prop to specify the total number of items in the virtual list.
Access the index and style parameters within the row renderer to display content and apply positioning.
Modify the row component to conditionally render content based on the index from the data array.
Use the height and width props to define the visible viewport dimensions of the virtualized list.
Invoke the FixedSizeList component within a parent component to display the virtualized content.
Compare the performance characteristics of a virtualized list versus a standard rendered list.
